description: AICTIONBOT™ sourcing plan comparison by KULIC Advisory (tool 67). Takes the old and the new version of a sourcing plan with one row per category (category, annual volume, approach, savings target in percent, due date, owner) and matches the rows by category. Returns the critical changes (red: a category dropped from the plan, a target removed or cut by a third or more, a due date moved by more than 90 days), the other changes (yellow: moderately lowered target, moved date, changed approach, no owner), raised targets, new categories and changed volumes for information, the planned effect per year before and after (volume times target), the questions to answer before approval and the next step. Pass two arrays (old_rows and new_rows) or one array rows with a version column (Old or New; German: Alt or Neu). Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. The effect is the plan's own target, not a promise. To work out the route for one category use plan_sourcing. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

new_rows.description: New version with the same columns.

old_rows.description: Old version: category, volume, approach, target (percent), due (date), owner. German column names work too (warengruppe, volumen, vorgehen, ziel, abschluss, verantwortlich).

rows.description: Alternative to old_rows and new_rows: one list with a version column (Old or New) plus the columns above.

name: compare_sourcing_plans
title: Sourcing plan old against new: dropped categories, lowered or removed targets, postponed dates, changed approach, planned effect before and after
